system.description: You touch an object and read its physical memory.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the memory has sound.
outcomes.success: You see a silent, flickering memory of the last significant event that happened in its presence.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The memory you see is your own death, or something like it. You are Frightened of the object until your next Long Rest. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
